newsitem.title: USA: SC&T expects improved performance in Q1.
newsitem.headline: SC&T expects improved performance in Q1.

text.p: SC&T International Inc said Friday it expects to post a lower loss in this year's first quarter than it reported in the same period a year ago.
The company, which went public in December, did not offer a specific projection and did not disclose the level of the loss it recorded in last year's first quarter.
It also said it expects to post revenues of $1.7 million compared with $1 million reported in the same period a year ago.

Earlier this week, the company released results for the 1996 fiscal year ended June 30, showing a net loss of $2,688,145, or $0.58 per share, compared with a net loss of $792,331, or $0.21 per share, for the prior fiscal year.
The company could not be reached for further comment.
